Only design partners get in first: phase 1 (chart builder + saved views) is feature-complete on staging behind the `dash_v2` flag, and the design-partner beta opens Wednesday Dec 9 for 5 customers — Orbitly, Zest Grocers and three accounts from the October trial cohort [4]. Everyone else waits for general availability, targeted for late January and explicitly not committed [4].

If a customer outside that list asks, the instruction to the team is not to promise access; a waitlist opens in January [5]. That already came up with Pinecrest Logistics, who asked for beta access for their evaluation and were only told it would be checked [6] — the Slack thread shows Sam asking whether Pinecrest could get in, and Priya's answer is that the beta is the 5 named partners only [5][4].
